abstract: A case of transverse ectopia of the right testicle and the left testicular tumor with the immature uterus and the fallopian tubes is reported. The patient, a 27-year-old married man, was admitted to our hospital with the suspicion of left testicular tumor and right undescended testicle. In his left scrotum, a double hen-egg-sized tumor was palpable and the right scrotum was empty. Exploration of the left inguinal canal disclosed double testicles with hernia uteri inguinalis. The right testicle showed transverse ectopia, and the histological finding of the left testicle was choriocarcinoma. In our review of the Japanese literature, we discovered 67 reported cases of transverse testicular ectopia. 33 (49.3%) out of 67 cases had a uterus and 9 cases (13.4%) had testicular tumor.
abstract_ja: 右精巣の横方向異所性（transverse testicular ectopia）と、未熟子宮および卵管を伴う左精巣腫瘍の症例を報告する。症例は27歳の既婚男性で、左精巣腫瘍と右精巣未下降の疑いで当院を受診した。左陰嚢には鶏卵大の二重の腫瘤を触知し、右陰嚢は空であった。左鼠径管の探索で、二重の精巣と鼠径ヘルニア内子宮が確認された。右精巣はtransverse testicular ectopiaを示し、左精巣の組織学的所見は絨毛癌であった。日本の文献の検討では、transverse testicular ectopiaの報告67例が見つかり、そのうち33例（49.3%）が子宮を有し、9例（13.4%）が精巣腫瘍を有していた。
